headlines.title: Banks say Healey is planning Budget tax raid on their profits
headlines.summary: Senior banking executives have told the BBC they expect to be "on the menu" in the chancellor's Budget tax later this month.

headlines.title: Unicredit cleared by ECB to take control of Commerzbank
headlines.summary: The European Central Bank has ruled that UniCredit may exceed the 30 percent shareholding threshold in Commerzbank. From 2027 the Piazza Gae Aulenti lender will take control of the German bank.

headlines.title: DW
headlines.summary: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

headlines.title: Late discord delays Franco-German deal on Made in Europe, car emissions
headlines.summary: The draft pact supports tighter eligibility rules for non-EU countries to participate in public procurement and public support, and softens the 2035 combustion engine ban.

headlines.title: I find it quite demoralising in store - why I do all my shopping online
headlines.summary: After Primark announced plans for home delivery, we hear from women who never go into clothes stores.

headlines.title: Azerbaijan hosts rare summit of both converging and opposing Middle East and Asian leaders
headlines.summary: Middle East and Asian leaders, including those on opposing sides of conflicts, held a rare summit in Baku focusing on confidence-building measures, addressing differences but also the opportunities of new transport corridors and economic realignments amid evolving global reshapes.

headlines.title: Trump s diesel deal with Russia is unlikely to significantly lower global fuel prices despite expectations of rapid relief
headlines.summary: As the world s largest diesel exporter, the US benefits from high prices. At home, however, consumers are feeling the strain of rising living costs. Why Donald Trump s deal with Russia is unlikely to change that.

headlines.title: Shorten EU budget to 3 or 4 years, Cyprus president tells POLITICO
headlines.summary: “You don’t know what’s going to be the situation in 2030, 2031," Nikos Christodoulides says in interview.

headlines.title: Nandy 'minded to intervene' in Sky's £1.6bn takeover of ITV entertainment arm
headlines.summary: The culture secretary says the deal could affect free expression in the media and the variety of Britain's news landscape.

headlines.title: Norway may open €2 trillion wealth fund to nuclear weapons makers
headlines.summary: Norway's sovereign wealth fund, the world's largest with assets of more than €2 trillion, may once again be allowed to invest in firms that make nuclear weapons under a proposal published on Thursday.

headlines.title: Germany s China calculation shifts as import pressures eclipse export benefits
headlines.summary: Germany has long resisted tougher action against China, fearing retaliation. But rising pressure on key industries has pushed Berlin to seek stronger EU trade-defense powers to protect its industrial base.

headlines.title: ‘No logic’: Finland slams Trump for siding with Putin against Ukraine
headlines.summary: Prime Minister Petteri Orpo tells POLITICO the U.S. is going against its allies and warns Europe must find a way to keep Ukraine in the fight, even if it means reopening the debate over raiding Russian assets.

headlines.title: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut
headlines.summary: It comes as some investors have become concerned about the amount of money being spent on AI infrastructure.

headlines.title: IMF warns attacks on Saudi Arabia could hurt global economy after strike on Aramco headquarters
headlines.summary: Aramco's headquarters has been hit, flights are suspended and oil prices are rising. The IMF warns that the economic fallout from attacks on Saudi Arabia could be felt worldwide.

headlines.title: Macron warns EU leaders they need to agree budget by end of year
headlines.summary: Starting from January, there will be no political room for concluding an agreement, French president tells summit.

headlines.title: 'I paid thousands to a company for jobs that never came'
headlines.summary: Apurv Patel is one of several people who say they were promised job opportunities that did not appear.

headlines.title: Anthropic revenue jumps 46% to $16.8bn as AI firm eyes record $2 trillion IPO valuation
headlines.summary: AI developer Anthropic grew its sales by about 46% to $16.8 billion (€15bn) last quarter and turned an adjusted profit, it told investors on Wednesday, weeks before a November stock market debut that could value it at up to $2 trillion (€1.79bn).

headlines.title: EU leaders summit descends into 3-hour argument over taxing car emissions
headlines.summary: Right-wing leaders used discussions to attack one of Europe's most important climate policies.

headlines.title: Living with a stink? Technology might help
headlines.summary: Smells from rubbish dumps and industrial facilities are being more carefully monitored.

headlines.title: EIB seeks cross-border projects to boost Central Asia’s economic development
headlines.summary: The European Investment Bank is seeking to expand cross-border investments in Central Asia, while requiring projects to meet environmental standards and offer benefits for both regional economies and European industry.
